objects.name: DPFF - DevSecOps Pipeline Forensics Framework
objects.description: Automated forensic analysis tool for CI/CD pipeline security.

objects.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse Unix shell commands and scripts for execution.

objects.name: Valid Accounts
objects.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts.

objects.name: Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Supply Chain
objects.description: Adversaries may manipulate software dependencies delivered to targets.

objects.name: Implant Internal Image
objects.description: Adversaries may implant container images with malicious code.

objects.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
objects.description: Adversaries may attempt to make payloads difficult to discover or analyze.

objects.name: Escape to Host
objects.description: Adversaries may break out of a container to gain access to the host.

objects.name: Supply Chain Compromise
objects.description: Adversaries may manipulate the supply chain to compromise targets.
